Preview exposure options

Source: R/preview.R
preview_exposure.Rd

Shows one image of a channel with 25 combinations of display ranges, ordered by how the image looks: from left to right it gets brighter (the upper end, max, decreases), from top to bottom the background gets darker (the lower end, min, increases). The outlined panel is the current setting of the montage (see adjust_exposure()), surrounded by up to two steps in each direction; at the ends of the scale (e.g. min = "p0") it moves off the middle. Read off the percentiles of the panel you like and set them with adjust_exposure().

Usage

preview_exposure(montage, channel, ...)

Arguments

montage

A tidymontage() object.

channel

The channel to preview. Can be left out if the montage has one channel only.

...

Conditions that pick one image of the channel, as in dplyr::filter(), e.g. mutant == "L59A". By default, the brightest image is shown.

Value

A montage with the options. Print it to see them.

Details

The percentiles are computed from all images of the channel, as in the montage, so the preview looks like the final figure. Repeat the preview after adjusting the exposure to refine it further.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
montage |> preview_exposure("Cy3")
montage |> preview_exposure("Cy3", mutant == "L59A")
} # }
